subject: Executive demo — need to move week due to RSA / re:Invent overlap

Cc: Maya Singh <maya.singh@aceropay.com>, procurement@aceropay.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive demo — need to move week due to RSA / re:Invent overlap

Karthik — thanks for coordinating. We confirmed an exec presence for the demo on 2026-06-10, but heads-up: several of our GTM leaders just got pulled into RSA prep and some travel dates are shifting. Can we look at alternate windows that week or the following? Our top constraint is having both product and payments leadership on the call.

Short list of options from our side: 2026-06-16 morning PT, 2026-06-17 late afternoon PT, or any day the week of 2026-06-21. If none of those work, happy to push to early July.

Appreciate the flexibility — Jared
Director, Strategic Accounts
AceroPay
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Jared O'Neill <jared.oneill@aceropay.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Executive demo — need to move week due to RSA / re:Invent overlap

Jared — thanks for the heads up. Sorry to hear RSA prep landed on you guys. We can absolutely be flexible. Can you confirm how long you want the session to be (30 vs 45 vs 60)? I want to make sure we bring the right people.

If it's a 30-minute exec walkthrough, we can do: 2026-06-16 09:00 PT or 2026-06-17 16:00 PT. For a 60-minute deep-dive (including ops/Q&A) we'd prefer the week of 06/21 when our infra and product leads are back from an internal offsite.

I'll tentatively hold both 06/16 09:00 and 06/17 16:00 for 48 hours. Ben, can you bring the dedicated capacity slides and the mutual action plan? Lauren, can you own the invite update and add the procurement thread?

— Karthik
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Karthik — copied the two slide variants into the shared Drive and attached the updated MAP (AceroPay_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf). The 30-minute deck is focused on latency/cost wins and a short live demo; the 60-minute includes a deeper ops runbook and SLA discussion.

If we go 06/17 late afternoon we should limit to 30 and schedule a follow-up for the ops deep-dive. Also, FYI: our team has a company-wide blackout the week of 06/21 for an internal offsite; we should avoid that week — alternative early July dates would be 07/06 or 07/07.

Attachments: AceroPay_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.pdf; RDW-demo-slide-deck-30min.pptx

— Ben
